research_scope: Direct-source follow-up on five canonical null race_restriction CaC-usable skills.

records.name: Blaster Stream
records.evidence: Current skill documentation identifies Blaster Stream as Kale's Ultimate and lists Future Warrior acquisition through PQ148; no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated. The official Dragon Ball site confirms the skill and its Kale association, but does not establish a CaC restriction.

records.name: Break Strike
records.evidence: Reference material identifies Break Strike as a common Evasive Skill obtainable by the Future Warrior through the Skill Shop and used across many character types. No explicit narrower CaC race/gender/form condition was found; broad character use is not itself a race classification.

records.name: Chaotic Time Impact
records.evidence: Current skill documentation identifies Chaotic Time Impact as Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain)'s Ultimate and PQ184 reward. Separate Future Warrior-oriented sources identify the Future Warrior as capable of using the technique, but no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction was found. Frieza character ownership does not establish a CaC restriction.

records.name: Evil Explosion (Super)
records.evidence: Reference material identifies Evil Explosion as Piccolo's Super Skill and explicitly states that the Future Warrior can learn/use it. The source does not impose a CaC race/gender/form restriction. A Saiyan-specific behavior while using a Super Saiyan Awoken Skill is a move interaction, not a general race restriction on equipping the skill.

records.name: Minus Energy Power Ball
records.evidence: Reference material identifies Minus Energy Power Ball as Omega Shenron's Ultimate and explicitly states that it can be obtained/used by the Future Warrior. No explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction was found. Omega Shenron/Mira character association is not sufficient to infer a race restriction.

policy: Only explicit CaC eligibility wording establishing a narrower race/gender/form condition can populate race_restriction. Future Warrior usability without such a condition remains null.
